claim_limits: This is a controlled compiler microbenchmark.
Invocation p95 is not a serving latency percentile.
The eager execution is a correctness reference, not a performance competitor.
The no-break case gates drift validity and does not establish nested-break benefit.
No serving, model throughput, or model quality conclusion follows.

current_research_publication_decision.accepted_tradeoff: the steady route passes while the startup route and its seed-1 no-break startup control do not pass
current_research_publication_decision.scope: the exact disclosed research package under research/2026-10-22_nested-graph-breaks

decision_boundary: The fixed protocol scientifically qualifies the steady invocation route and does not qualify the startup route. At experiment closure, the historical all-gates condition withheld the planned Whiteboard content. The current explicit authorization accepts the disclosed startup tradeoff and permits this exact research package. It does not change a scientific gate or retroactively pass the startup route.

historical_all_gates_content_decision.reason: Primary first-ten startup improvement fails in all four seeds, and no-break first-ten control fails at seed 1. The frozen protocol permits a steady route win, but that does not satisfy the human all-gates content condition.
historical_all_gates_content_decision.requirement: Only make the Whiteboard post if it passes all fixed gates.

historical_evidence_boundary.hardware: one NVIDIA B200 executed each worker
historical_evidence_boundary.profiler: retained PyTorch Chrome CPU and CUDA profile summaries

protocol_scientific_verdict.control_rule: no_break_depth4 steady median baseline/candidate ratio must be within [0.95, 1.05] for every seed on both routes; startup also requires its cold first-10 ratio within [0.95, 1.05] for every seed
protocol_scientific_verdict.failure_semantics: INCONCLUSIVE retains the full raw matrix; the measurement gate, control-validity gate, capture qualification, or more than one did not pass, so no qualified optimization-win claim is supported
protocol_scientific_verdict.startup_rule: observed minimum of four paired-seed cold-first-10 speedup ratios >= 1.10; candidate steady invocation p95 no more than 3% above baseline for every seed
protocol_scientific_verdict.steady_rule: observed minimum of four paired-seed median speedup ratios >= 1.10; candidate invocation p95 <= baseline for every seed
protocol_scientific_verdict.verdict_scope: predeclared performance thresholds, no-break control validity, and two-arm CUDA Graph capture qualification
